description: This file defines the Step3 controller class for the installation process of OpenCart, handling the display of the third step of installation and saving database configuration data.

classes.name: Step3
classes.description: Controller for step 3 of the OpenCart installation process, managing the database setup and moving to the next installation step.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the installation step 3 page with form inputs for database configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, attempts database connection, writes configuration files, and redirects to the next step.
